passive.name: Contentment
passive.text: Increases the wearer's Break Effect by **60/70/80/90/100%**. After the wearer uses Ultimate to attack enemy targets, inflicts the targets with the "Woefree" state, lasting for **2** turn(s). While in "Woefree," enemy targets take **10/12/14/16/18%** increased DMG. The effect of increasing DMG taken is additionally boosted by **8/10/12/14/16%** if the wearer's current Break Effect is **150%** or higher.

passive.name: Enjoy With Rapture
passive.text: At the start of the wearer's turn, regenerates **8/10/12/14/16** Energy for a randomly chosen ally (excluding the wearer) whose current Energy is lower than **50%**.

passive.name: Mutual Healing
passive.text: Increases the wearer's Energy Regeneration Rate by **8/10/12/14/16%** and increases Outgoing Healing when they use their Ultimate by **12/15/18/21/24%**.

passive.name: Hypothesis
passive.text: Increases the wearer's Break Effect by **24/30/36/42/48%**. After using Basic ATK, restores HP for the wearer by an amount equal to **2/2.5/3/3.5/4%** of Max HP plus **800**.

passive.name: Farewell
passive.text: Increases the wearer's Outgoing Healing by **12/15/18/21/24%**. When an ally target's current HP percentage is greater than or equal to **50%**, increases the DMG dealt by **12/14/16/18/20%**.

passive.name: Cure and Repair
passive.text: Increases the wearer's Outgoing Healing by **10/12.5/15/17.5/20%**. When using Skill, regenerates **2/2.5/3/3.5/4** Energy for all allies.

passive.name: Tiny Light
passive.text: Increases the wearer's Max HP by **16/20/24/28/32%**. When using Basic ATK or Skill, restores all allies' HP by an amount equal to **2/2.5/3/3.5/4%** of their respective Max HP.

passive.name: Denizens of Abundance
passive.text: After the wearer uses their Basic ATK, their next action will be Advanced Forward by **12/14/16/18/20%**.

substatLine: SPD (as much as possible) > Break Effect % (up to 150%) > Effect RES% > HP% = DEF%
tracePriority: Novel Concoction (A2) > Bottoms Up (A6) > Organic Yeast (A4)

entries.name: Corkage Fee
entries.text: Deals Fire DMG equal to **100%** of Gallagher's ATK to one designated enemy target.

entries.name: Nectar Blitz
entries.text: Deals Fire DMG equal to **250%** of Gallagher's ATK to one designated enemy target. Reduces the target's ATK by **15%**, lasting for **2** turn(s).

entries.name: Special Brew
entries.text: Immediately heals a target ally for **1600** HP.

entries.name: Champagne Etiquette
entries.text: Inflicts Besotted on all enemies, lasting for **2** turn(s). At the same time, deals Fire DMG equal to **150%** of Gallagher's ATK to all enemies, and enhances his next Basic ATK to Nectar Blitz.

entries.name: Tipsy Tussle
entries.text: The Besotted state makes targets receive **12%** more Break DMG. Every time a Besotted target gets attacked by an ally, the attacking ally's HP is restored by **640**.

entries.name: Artisan Elixir
entries.text: Immediately attacks the enemy. Upon entering battle, inflicts Besotted on all enemies, lasting for **2** turn(s). And deals Fire DMG equal to **50%** of Gallagher's ATK to all enemies.

entries.name: Novel Concoction
entries.text: Increases this unit's Outgoing Healing by an amount equal to **50%** of Break Effect, up to a maximum Outgoing Healing increase of **75%**.

entries.name: Organic Yeast
entries.text: After using the Ultimate, immediately advances action for this unit by 100%.

entries.name: Bottoms Up
entries.text: When Gallagher uses Nectar Blitz to attack Besotted enemies, the HP Restore effect of his Talent will also apply to teammates for this time.

entries.name: Salty Dog
entries.text: When entering the battle, Gallagher regenerates 20 Energy and increases Effect RES by 50%.

entries.name: Lion's Tail
entries.text: When using the Skill, dispels 1 debuff(s) from the designated ally. At the same time, increases their Effect RES by 30% for 2 turn(s).

entries.name: Corpse Reviver
entries.text:
Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Basic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. 10.

entries.name: Last Word
entries.text: Extends the duration of the Besotted state inflicted by Gallagher's Ultimate by 1 turn(s).

entries.name: Death in the Afternoon
entries.text:
Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Talent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.

entries.name: Blood and Sand
entries.text: Increases Gallagher's Break Effect by 20% and Weakness Break Efficiency by 20%.
